stem_book: A small sphere is projected with a velocity of 3 m s⁻¹ in a direction 60° from the horizontal y-axis, on the smooth inclined plane of inclination 30° (x-axis up the line of greatest slope; take g = 10 m s⁻²). The motion of sphere takes place in the x-y plane. Calculate the magnitude 2v (in m s⁻¹) of its velocity after 2 s.
reason: Key 3 (book SB L7 Q14 key 1.5 m/s) keeps only the horizontal component; with g sin30° = 5 m/s² along −x, v_x = 2.6 − 10 = −7.4, so |v| ≈ 7.55 and 2v ≈ 15.1 (not an integer).
